en.hubeali: Abu Ali Al Ashary, from Muhammad Bin Abdul Jabbar, from Al Hajjal, from Safwan Al Jamaal who said,

‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Had the people known the true nature of the carriers as Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Made (Bearing the load) for the weak, they would not consider the animals as expensive’.
en.sarwar: 2. Abu Ali al-Ash‘ariy has narrated from Muhammad ibn ‘Abd al-Jabbar from al-Hajj al from Safwan al-Jammal who has said the following: “
Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘Had people known the fact of how Allah gives strength to the weak to carry the load, carry-animals would not become expensive.’”
